description: This file defines a React component 'UserCustomProgressModal' that displays a modal showing user progress on a resource, including fetching data, handling UI interactions, and rendering a roadmap with progress highlights.

methods.name: getUserProgress
methods.description: Fetches user progress data from API based on userId, resourceType, and resourceId.

methods.name: getRoadmapSVG
methods.description: Fetches roadmap SVG data from API based on resourceId.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles closing the modal, cleaning URL params, and reloading or calling callback.
